_doc: The red line's colour (MarkPass, an elite's or a boss's blow on the ground): the owner's pick is "look" (one line). Each look is a set of MarkPass.Tune numbers over its defaults ("scarlet" = the defaults). salmon = the old amber-over-dirt look (before 27 Oct) matched on screen: bed tint (1, tg, tb) and rims (1, hg, hb) in linear light, the fold (fs the saturation, fh the hue in degrees) opened for a warmer red, k the bed's value against the ground's. Env MARK_LOOK=<name> overrides for shots; MARK_TUNE still overrides single numbers.
